description: This Java source file defines the MongoMetricsBuilder class, which implements the MetricsBuilder interface to provide timers and histograms using DittoMetrics, specifically tailored for MongoDB interactions within the Eclipse Ditto service utils. It includes methods for creating timers and histograms, and manages a maximum timer value accumulator.

classes.name: MongoMetricsBuilder
classes.description: An implementation of MetricsBuilder that utilizes DittoMetrics for MongoDB performance metrics, providing timers and histograms, and tracking maximum timer durations.

methods.name: timer
methods.description: Creates a MongoTimer that measures durations using DittoMetrics and updates the maximum timer nanos accumulator.

methods.name: histogram
methods.description: Creates a MongoHistogram that records values into DittoMetrics histograms.

methods.name: maxTimerNanos
methods.description: Returns the LongAccumulator object tracking the maximum timer duration in nanoseconds.
